title: Sporoderm-Broken Spore Powder (GLSP) Remodels the Gut Microbiota and Promotes Tryptophan-Derived Indole Metabolites to Maintain Intestinal Homeostasis.
snippet: sporoderm-broken spore powder (GLSP) has been historically documented for its anti-aging and anti-tumor effects. title: BMP-2 in Orthopedic Trauma and Limb Reconstruction: Current Evidence, Limitations, and Future Directions.
snippet: : Recombinant human bone morphogenetic protein-2 (rhBMP-2) is an osteoinductive agent increasingly used in many orthopedic cases such as fracture healing, nonunion, critical-sized bone defects, and limb reconstruction cases.
